gallery.artist: Martin Lewison from Forest Hills, NY, U.S.A.
gallery.description: Marriott built this and another theme park and called them Great America, each opening in 1976. But Marriott got out of the business, and after a messy process involving a land developer,  the city of Santa Clara, and a bunch of lawsuits, the park ended up being run by Kings Entertainment. Later Paramount bought Kings and more recently, Paramount sold its parks to Cedar Fair L.P., the current owner.
